business_problem: MCCC needed to replace manual student messaging and disconnected reporting with a more personalized, automated, and measurable engagement model that fit inside its existing Microsoft stack.
solution_summary: Montgomery County Community College expanded its existing Dynamics 365 estate with Dynamics 365 Marketing, Power BI, and Azure integrations to centralize student data and automate personalized communications. The system combines messages, scheduling, reporting, and engagement history in one environment so staff can orchestrate recurring student journeys instead of composing and tracking campaigns manually. Power BI provides goal-based reporting and visibility into whether students are engaging, while Azure supports the additional data integration needed to unify the student record. This gives the college a 360-degree view of each student’s journey and a feedback loop for improving future outreach. By embedding marketing automation and analytics into the existing Microsoft stack, MCCC reduced manual workload, improved message consistency, and built a platform for richer relationships between staff and students.
